Nila Gumbad and Arab Serai Precinct

A 105-minute heritage walk in Nizamuddin, Delhi

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and location. We adapt the length, level and language, and prepare a quotation. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you examine the lesser-known built landscape around Humayun's Tomb.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Regional orientation near Humayun ensemble
  • Accessible Nila Gumbad viewpoint
  • Arab Serai entrance view
  • Comparison stop

How the time is spent

  1. Regional orientation near Humayun ensemble 20 min

    Locate Nila Gumbad and Arab Serai on historical plan.

    You: context map

  2. Accessible Nila Gumbad viewpoint 35 min

    Discuss tile, dome and patronage.

    You: describe elevation

  3. Arab Serai entrance view 30 min

    Discuss craft labour, lodging and building complex.

    You: illustrate relation

  4. Comparison stop 20 min

    Contrast function of tomb and ancillary precinct.

    You: evidence table

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Nila Gumbad & Arab Serai Precinct using material evidence and a site map.
  • Examine the lesser-known built landscape around Humayun's Tomb.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.

Where
Nizamuddin, Delhi
For
Schools, colleges, the public and private groups
Length
1.5 to 2 hours
When
Any day you choose. Early morning is best in the warmer months.
Led by
A historian or archaeologist who specialises in Delhi's buildings
Language
English, Hindi or both. Other languages on request, through our partners.
Group size
Agreed with you. Smaller and larger groups are welcome.
Meeting point
Agreed with you. A map location is shared once the date is confirmed.
What to bring
Comfortable shoes, water and a hat. The ground is uneven in places.
Entry fees
Monument entry fees, where charged, are not included.
Price
Quoted for your group
